hook: You have no idea how big the Sun is

slides.headline: 1.3 million Earths
slides.body: That's how many Earths could fit inside the Sun if you packed them in.

slides.headline: 99.86% of everything
slides.body: The Sun holds almost all the mass in our solar system. Jupiter is most of what's left.

slides.headline: 8 minutes 20 seconds
slides.body: Sunlight you see right now left the Sun over 8 minutes ago, travelling 150 million km.

slides.headline: Yet it's just average
slides.body: Betelgeuse, the red star in Orion's shoulder, is roughly 750 times wider than the Sun.

caption: Our Sun feels huge, but in the universe it's pretty ordinary. Which fact surprised you most?
